title: AWE Observability
description: Operations and usage of an AWE application: executions, durations and errors of queries, maintains and actions; screens opened, connected users, logins, exports and files, from the awe-observability-spring-boot-starter

panels.title: Queries per second
panels.description: Query executions per second (cache hits are not counted)

panels.title: Maintains per second
panels.description: Maintain executions per second

panels.title: Actions per second
panels.description: Action executions per second

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of query, maintain and action executions that failed or answered with an error

panels.title: Users connected
panels.description: Users with at least one open connection now. Counted per instance: a user connected to two instances counts twice

panels.title: Open connections
panels.description: Open connections now (one per browser tab)

panels.title: Screens opened
panels.description: Screens opened in the selected time range. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"} - awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"}[$__range]) and awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"} offset $__range) or awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Successful logins in the selected time range. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="SUCCESS"} - awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="SUCCESS"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="SUCCESS"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="SUCCESS"}[$__range]) and awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="SUCCESS"} offset $__range) or awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="SUCCESS"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed logins
panels.description: Failed login attempts in the selected time range. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="FAILURE"} - awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="FAILURE"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="FAILURE"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="FAILURE"}[$__range]) and awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="FAILURE"} offset $__range) or awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN",outcome="FAILURE"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Exports
panels.description: Prints and exports in the selected time range (one per format). Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} - awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"}[$__range]) and awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} offset $__range) or awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Most opened options
panels.description: Times each option was opened in the selected time range, with the screen it shows. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (id, screen) (clamp_min(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"} - awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"}[$__range]) and awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"} offset $__range) or awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option"}))

panels.title: Screens opened per minute (top 10)
panels.description: Options opened per minute, the ten most opened

panels.title: Screens with errors
panels.description: Options whose screen failed to build in the selected time range. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (id, screen) (clamp_min(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option",outcome="error"} - awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option",outcome="error"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option",outcome="error"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option",outcome="error"}[$__range]) and awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option",outcome="error"} offset $__range) or awe_screen_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$option",outcome="error"}) > 0)

panels.description: Average time the server takes to build each option, the ten slowest on average

panels.title: Longest time to build the screen (top 10)
panels.description: Longest build of each option, the ten slowest

panels.title: Users connected
panels.description: Users with at least one open connection and open connections, over time

panels.title: Logins by channel
panels.description: Login attempts by channel (WEB, SSO, REST) and outcome, one bar per interval (at least one minute) so the legend total is the real count

targets.expr: sum by (channel, outcome) (clamp_min(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN"} - awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN"} offset $__interval, 0) unless resets(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN"}[$__interval]) > 0 or (increase(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN"}[$__interval]) and awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN"} offset $__interval) or awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGIN"})

panels.title: Logouts by cause
panels.description: Session ends by cause: EXPLICIT (the user), PROVIDER (identity provider) and EXPIRED (session timeout), one bar per interval (at least one minute) so the legend total is the real count

targets.expr: sum by (cause) (clamp_min(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGOUT"} - awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGOUT"} offset $__interval, 0) unless resets(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGOUT"}[$__interval]) > 0 or (increase(awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGOUT"}[$__interval]) and awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGOUT"} offset $__interval) or awe_security_audit_events_total{application="$application",type="LOGOUT"})

panels.title: Exports by format
panels.description: Prints and exports of each format in the selected time range. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: sum by (format) (clamp_min(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} - awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"}[$__range]) and awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} offset $__range) or awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"})

panels.title: Most exported screens
panels.description: Prints and exports of each screen in the selected time range. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (id) (clamp_min(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} - awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"}[$__range]) and awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"} offset $__range) or awe_export_seconds_count{application="$application"}))

panels.title: Export duration by format
panels.description: Mean and longest time to generate an export, by format

panels.title: Files uploaded and downloaded
panels.description: Files transferred by direction (upload, download), one bar per interval (at least one minute) so the legend total is the real count

targets.expr: sum by (direction) (clamp_min(awe_files_bytes_count{application="$application"} - awe_files_bytes_count{application="$application"} offset $__interval, 0) unless resets(awe_files_bytes_count{application="$application"}[$__interval]) > 0 or (increase(awe_files_bytes_count{application="$application"}[$__interval]) and awe_files_bytes_count{application="$application"} offset $__interval) or awe_files_bytes_count{application="$application"})

panels.title: Bytes uploaded and downloaded
panels.description: Bytes transferred by direction (upload, download), one bar per interval (at least one minute) so the legend total is the real count

targets.expr: sum by (direction) (clamp_min(awe_files_bytes_sum{application="$application"} - awe_files_bytes_sum{application="$application"} offset $__interval, 0) unless resets(awe_files_bytes_sum{application="$application"}[$__interval]) > 0 or (increase(awe_files_bytes_sum{application="$application"}[$__interval]) and awe_files_bytes_sum{application="$application"} offset $__interval) or awe_files_bytes_sum{application="$application"})

panels.title: Most executed query ids
panels.description: Executions of each query id in the selected time range. It counts every query execution, whatever launched it: the target action of the data actions, the initial loads, the maintains and services that run queries, and the queries of the framework itself. A query served from the cache is not an execution and is not counted. Exact, including the series that first appear in the range; if the application restarted inside the range, the count of the series it reset is the Prometheus estimate (increase)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (id) (clamp_min(awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id"} - awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id"}[$__range]) and awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id"} offset $__range) or awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id"}))

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (id) (clamp_min(awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id",outcome="error"} - awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id",outcome="error"} offset $__range, 0) unless resets(awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id",outcome="error"}[$__range]) > 0 or (increase(awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id",outcome="error"}[$__range]) and awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id",outcome="error"} offset $__range) or awe_query_seconds_count{application="$application",id=~"$id",outcome="error"}) > 0)
